- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/07/21 (Fri) 05:09
- [USER] User asked how to make bak kut teh.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bak kut teh is a traditional Chinese soup dish made with pork ribs, herbs, and spices.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A simple recipe for bak kut teh was provided, including ingredients and instructions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for bak kut teh: 1 pound pork ribs, 2 cups water, 1 tablespoon bak kut teh spice mix, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 teaspoon grated ginger, 1 teaspoon white pepper, 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making bak kut teh: 
  1. Combine pork ribs, water, bak kut teh spice mix, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, and white pepper in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 1 hour.
  2. Mix cornstarch with water to form a slurry, stir into the pot, and simmer for another 15 minutes until thickened and pork is tender.
  3. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and soy sauce if desired.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Note: The recipe is a simplified version of bak kut teh, and ingredients and methods may vary by region or personal preference.
- [USER] User requested more information about the bak kut teh spice mix.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The bak kut teh spice mix typically includes star anise, cloves, cinnamon, fennel seeds, and white pepper.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The spice mix is added to the soup for flavor and aroma.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bak kut teh spice mix can be purchased at most Asian grocery stores or made at home.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A simple recipe for homemade bak kut teh spice mix was provided, including ingredients and instructions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for homemade bak kut teh spice mix: 2 tablespoons star anise, 2 tablespoons cloves, 2 tablespoons cinnamon, 1 tablespoon fennel seeds, 1 tablespoon white pepper.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making bak kut teh spice mix:
  1. Grind star anise, cloves, cinnamon, and fennel seeds until finely ground.
  2. Stir in white pepper.
  3. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 6 months. Use as needed in bak kut teh recipes.
